runner.scope: Reviewed adapter-qq commits were installed from detached worktrees. Chatrecorder and wordcloud probes compiled only the target function, model, or migration body from each detached worktree with controlled in-memory collaborators.
runner.credential_policy: GitHub and model API token environment variables were removed from every package probe process; extracted contract probes do not access the network.
runner.limitations: The chatrecorder schema probe validates the reported identifier against model and migration capacities but does not claim a live PostgreSQL round-trip. The wordcloud probe validates per-target control flow without contacting QQ.

results.buggy_observation: payload_to_event on Dispatch(type='RESUMED', data='') raised TypeError: 'str' object is not a mapping.
results.fixed_observation: The identical Dispatch returned ResumedEvent without unpacking the string.
results.environment: Windows, CPython 3.11, detached adapter-qq worktrees, uv isolated environment

results.buggy_observation: Both C2C and group JSON bodies retained MessageReference objects and json.dumps raised Object of type MessageReference is not JSON serializable.
results.fixed_observation: Both bodies contained {'message_id': 'quoted-id'} dictionaries and serialized successfully.
results.environment: Windows, CPython 3.12, detached adapter-qq worktrees, stub HTTP request capture

results.buggy_observation: A content-only first msg_element was assigned as reply and _check_reply raised AttributeError for missing author.
results.fixed_observation: The content-only element was ignored without an exception, while an explicit type='reply' control still assigned reply and set to_me.
results.environment: Windows, CPython 3.11, detached adapter-qq worktrees, in-memory event collaborators

results.buggy_observation: The actual record_recv_msg body called datetime.fromtimestamp(1000000) and stored the host-local probe value.
results.fixed_observation: The actual function body called datetime.utcfromtimestamp(1000000) and stored the UTC probe value.
results.environment: Windows, CPython 3.12, target function compiled from detached worktree, in-memory record/session collaborators

results.buggy_observation: The actual model body declared message_id length 64, which cannot contain the report's 117-character QQ identifier; no widening migration existed.
results.fixed_observation: The actual model body declared length 255 and the added upgrade body altered message_id from 64 to 255, which contains the same identifier.
results.environment: Windows, CPython 3.12, model and migration bodies compiled from detached worktrees, no live PostgreSQL service

results.buggy_observation: The actual run_task body let the first target RuntimeError escape after only bad-group was attempted.
results.fixed_observation: The actual function body logged bad-group's failure, returned normally, and attempted good-group afterward.
results.environment: Windows, CPython 3.12, target async function compiled from detached worktree, in-memory scheduler and platform collaborators
